summary: Add opt-in GET /v1/client/ready-work evidence for ready demand in an explicit declared cohort at a current local graph cut. HEAD returns 405. Coverage is local graph demand, not immediate dispatchability or fleet-wide coverage.

replay.detail: No claim or projection replay changes; the read uses an existing published work cut and separately fences graph head and attention frontier.

schema.detail: No persistent schema, table, index or data rewrite changes.

rules.detail: No claim admission, permission or trust rule changes; no production cohort, threshold, dashboard or activation is included.

compatibility.detail: Additive opt-in HTTP read with an explicit cohort query, local-graph-cut coverage, evaluated_at, projection_frontier and ready_count. A publication above 5,000 work rows, graph-head mismatch, absent/unhealthy/mismatched attention frontier, replication catching up or diverged, expiry seen inside the pinned read, or an unresolved/non-live cohort declaration returns 503 ready-work-unavailable. No served work publication at entry, or expiry/publication-list or generation replacement seen after counting, returns 503 work-list-not-ready. Malformed cohorts return validation errors. Existing reads and clients are unchanged. HEAD is explicitly refused with 405 rather than running GET.

downtime.detail: No new startup work or coordinated deployment required.

manual.detail: No operator action or configuration migration required; consumers must explicitly request a cohort to use this evidence.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or rollback restrictions; reverting removes the additive endpoint.
